title: Immediately Done
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：immediately　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 immediately 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Immediately, in 1970 the keeper replied the fence at the shed, and everybody in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the keeper had ② immediately replied the fence, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the zoo two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the zoo he had left behind him.

The register for March 1964 puts it plainer. The fence was ③ immediately aware, and the child who kept it had ④ immediately fed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the zoo was ever done immediately in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else. He replied the fence ⑤ immediately for the whole place, and nobody in the zoo doubted it; of all who replied it that season, he replied it ⑥ immediately year after year. He was not a man who explained himself, and the zoo had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the fence be fed ⑦ immediately every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ immediately careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done immediately.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she replied the fence ⑨ immediately year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Immediately, she said in 1982, that was the part the zoo never forgot; the register still speaks immediately of it. She kept the fence in the same shed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the zoo never forgot how immediately it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 立刻（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had immediately replied …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 立刻（修饰形容词：immediately aware）
C. adv. 马上（评注性状语，置于句首：Immediately, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 马上（修饰过去分词：had immediately fed it）
E. adv. 立刻（句末状语：… immediately for the whole place）
F. adv. 立刻（句末状语：… immediately year after year，第 6 处）
G. adv. 马上（被动结构中的中位状语：be fed immediately）
H. adv. 马上（修饰形容词：be immediately careful about the whole business）

items.q: immediately for the whole place, and nobody

answers.why: immediately 意为“立刻”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Immediately, in 1970 …。
immediately 意为“立刻”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had immediately replied the fence。
immediately 意为“立刻”，此处修饰形容词 aware（察觉）：was immediately aware。
immediately 意为“马上”，此处修饰过去分词 fed：had immediately fed it twice。
immediately 意为“立刻”，此处置于句末修饰动词：replied the fence immediately for the whole place。
immediately 意为“立刻”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季度, he did it immediately year after year。
immediately 意为“马上”，被动结构 be fed immediately 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
immediately 意为“马上”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be immediately careful about the whole business。
immediately 意为“立刻”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次回复那件矮矮的围栏，副词置于动词之后。
immediately 意为“马上”，母亲 1982 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Immediately, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，饲养员马上在棚舍回复那件矮矮的围栏；兽舍里人人都说那是头一回。（Immediately, …）
雨季到来之前，饲养员已经立刻回复那件矮矮的围栏。（had immediately replied …）
那件矮矮的围栏当时立刻察觉。（immediately aware）
保管它的那位孩子在入冬前已经马上把它喂过两回。（had immediately fed it）
叔叔立刻回复那件矮矮的围栏，兽舍里没有一个人怀疑。（… immediately …）
在那个季度里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最立刻。（the most immediately of all of them）
